script: I found an issue with the customer profile. Open a customer, go to Addresses, add a new shipping address, select Germany as the country and save it. The new address appears correctly. But after refreshing the page, the country changes back to the United States. It should stay Germany.
facts: Steps in order: open a customer, go to Addresses, add a new shipping address, select Germany as the country, save
After saving, the new address appears correctly
After refreshing the page, the country changes back to the United States

traps.reason: Only a shipping address was mentioned
